title: Developer Tools
description: IoT device simulator for testing without real hardware. Available only in development environment.

seed.title: Generate Mock House
seed.description: Creates mock rooms and devices (TV, lights, plugs, sensors) linked to your account.

telemetry.title: Emit Manual Telemetry
telemetry.description: Injects a simulated telemetry event for a specific device.

connectivity.title: Force Connectivity
connectivity.description: Simulates a device's connection dropping or coming back online.
